data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves strengthened materially in 2018 (gross prior-year adverse movement of GBP 75.974m, a ~70.8% increase versus opening gross claims reserves) driven largely by adverse development in liability and property prior-year claims, with significant contribution from US catastrophe activity and large loss development. Named natural catastrophe losses (notably 2017 US hurricanes Irma/Harvey and 2018 Florence/Michael and California wildfires) and large liability development were cited as primary drivers.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience has been impacted by the US Cat events Hurricanes Florence and Michael and California Wildfires, although estimates for each remain within the syndicate's reinsurance retention.
The 2016 year of account has been impacted by the 2017 US Cat activity (most significantly Hurricanes Irma and Harvey), making up cGBP 6m of the loss.
continued impact in the 2018 calendar year from the volatility in Euro exchange rates and from some investment losses.
